title: AN ACT relating to eminent domain for solar energy projects.
subject: Cooperatives
Eminent Domain And Condemnation
Energy
Land Use
Property
Public Utilities

abstracts.abstract: Create a new section of KRS Chapter 416 to prohibit the construction of any solar electric generating or related transmission facility on any land that was acquired by eminent domain; amend KRS 416.570 to require that as part of the verified petition required to be filed prior to an exercise of eminent domain, a condemnor shall certify that the proposed condemnation will not violate the prohibition on constructing solar electric generating or transmission facilities on condemned land.
